## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes
- [ ] `uv run ruff check` and `uv run ruff format --check` pass
- [ ] Visual changes: before and after previews attached (`uv run zurich-air preview --scale 2`)
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour or settings changed (README, `docs/`, `config.example.toml`)
- [ ] No secrets or personal data: no API keys, Wi-Fi details, home coordinates, local paths or saved provider responses
